title: DLGPR Game AI Artifact: Charged-Time Compute-Budgeted GA-PSO-RL Scheduler
description: Reproducibility artifact for the DLGPR Game AI validation package. The archive contains source code, experiment runners, metadata-complete validation logs, statistical tables, figures, tests, and documentation for a charged-time compute-budgeted GA-PSO-RL scheduler. The manuscript source and manuscript PDF are intentionally excluded from this artifact.
